title: San Francisco Can Extend New Data Center Ban to 2 Years
summary:
A unanimous vote by city officials in San Francisco has blocked the development of new computing facilities to study the local environmental impact. This restriction, which halts all new data center construction for an initial 45 day period, may be extended for as long as 2 years. San Francisco is using the pause to examine how these resource heavy facilities affect the city's electricity grids, water supplies and pollution levels.

The moratorium directly affects the physical expansion of industry leaders like OpenAI and Anthropic, both of which are based in the city. While the initial ban is short term, the potential for a multi year extension forces AI developers to seek alternative locations for the massive compute infrastructure required to scale their models.
